_meta.description: The merge stamp on a client or contact that OpenRegister merged into another record (REQ-CRM-001, REQ-MDM-013): which record survived, its name and number, and when. MergedAwayRecordListener writes it on a merge and clears it on a reversal; MergedAwayRecordGuard keeps a stamped record read-only.

mergedInto.title: Merged into
mergedInto.description: The record this client was merged into. Empty while the client stands on its own.

mergedIntoLabel.title: Merged into (name)
mergedIntoLabel.description: The name and number of the record this client was merged into, such as Sanne J. de Vries (K-2019-01184).

mergedAt.title: Merged on
mergedAt.description: When this client was merged into another record.

mergedInto.title: Merged into
mergedInto.description: The record this contact was merged into. Empty while the contact stands on its own.

mergedIntoLabel.title: Merged into (name)
mergedIntoLabel.description: The name and number of the record this contact was merged into.

mergedAt.title: Merged on
mergedAt.description: When this contact was merged into another record.
